title: DELETE /api/projects/:id/milestones/:mid — delete milestone
description: Delete a milestone. Todos linked to this milestone have their milestone_id set to null (FK set null on delete handles this automatically).
acceptanceCriteria: DELETE requires auth and project ownership
Todos previously linked to this milestone remain with milestone_id = null

steps.details: 1) getOwnedProject. 2) Find milestone by id AND project_id. 3) Delete milestone record. 4) Return 200 { message: 'Milestone deleted' }.
Create milestone with linked todos. Delete milestone. Verify todos still exist with milestone_id = null.
